summary: VSee Health, Inc. filed an 8-K regarding a Standby Equity Purchase Agreement (SEPA) with YA II PN, LTD. on June 2, 2026, allowing the company to sell up to $10 million of common stock at 97% of the lowest daily VWAP over a three-day pricing period, with a $25,000 structuring fee and 532,481 commitment shares. This is a standard equity line facility (commonly known as an at-the-market offering variant) designed to provide working capital. The board is not recommending a special event; no acquisition, divestiture, or activist campaign is involved. The filing reflects routine financing, not a special situation. No definitive terms like premium or break fee apply. Investors should monitor future drawdowns and potential dilution.
